## Welcome!

I am a doctoral researcher at the Endowed Chair of Procurement (Prof. Dr. Christoph Bode), Area Operations Management, at the Business School of the University of Mannheim, where I joined in September 2026.

My research interests lie in supply chain risk management, supply chain finance, and the macroeconomic effects of supply chain disruptions. In my master's thesis I studied how global supply chain bottlenecks transmit to industrial production and producer prices in Germany and the United States.

Before joining the chair, I completed a M.Sc. in Economics at the University of Mannheim, including an exchange semester at the Solvay Brussels School of Economics and Management. Alongside my studies I worked in empirical economic research at the Chair of Economic Policy at the University of Mannheim and at ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, and gained practical experience at the interface of corporate finance and procurement.

If you would like to get in touch, I am happy to hear from you.
